_comment: The known accounts, and which service each one signs into.
Only Claude Code records its account email on disk. Every other CLI writes
sessions with no identity at all, so without this file 11.9% of measured
tokens - 5.56 billion - sit under placeholders like 'grok (local)' and are
missing from every per-account total. `services` is what lets that usage be
attributed to the person who paid for it.
EVIDENCE is recorded per mapping and is not decoration:
file    read out of the tool's own account file on disk, verifiable
owner   stated by the account holder; true, but not checkable from disk
A mapping with neither is a guess and does not belong here. This project has
already been wrong once by inferring identity from a directory name.
A tool with no mapping stays unattributed on purpose. Spreading it across
accounts by proportion would invent numbers that look like measurements.

profiles.label: API key (org 15a93e14-aabb-4293-8228-8c56a803d972)
profiles.why: API-key profile in ~/.claude-alt-api. Keys carry no email. The billing org came from the anthropic-organization-id response header, and it is NOT an org any of the logged-in accounts own - the directory name suggests it belongs to ~/.claude-alt and it does not.

profiles.label: DeepSeek backend (~/.my-claude)
profiles.why: A 0.0.0-leaked build pointed at DeepSeek: 12,959 deepseek-v4-pro and 2,727 deepseek-v4-flash calls, zero Claude models. Transcripts are byte-identical to Claude Code's, which is why its 1.41B was counted as Anthropic usage before totals were split on model id. Not an Anthropic account and has no email to find.
